newsitem.title: USA: Pfizer designs molecule against depression.
newsitem.headline: Pfizer designs molecule against depression.

text.p: Pfizer Inc said on Monday its scientists had designed a molecule that could eventually be used to treat people suffering from depression or anxiety.
The company said scientists at its Pfizer Central Research operation had designed a molecule that blocks the cascade of events in the brain that occur in response to stress.
It said the molecule could eventually be administered orally to patients suffering from anxiety or other forms of stress.
"This is a pathfinding scientific discovery. It will be some years before it is determined whether it will yield a new drug that is available to patients," it said.

The company said the compound arrests the action of a neurotransmitter called corticotropin releasing factor (CRF), which is believed to be an important chemical messenger for transmitting the stress response in the brain.
Excessive levels of that chemical signal can produce a host of central nervous system disorders, such as depression, anxiety, anorexia and post-traumatic stress disorder, it added.
